title: feat(spec)!: object-map, object-gantt and object-tree type navigation by reference, and one pin enumerates every z.unknown() member of ComponentPropsMap (#21464, stage 1)
body:
Part of #21464
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What this does

This is the first stage of the `ComponentPropsMap` `z.unknown()` close-out (triage `5961300594`, claim `5962381903`). It does two things.

1. **`navigation` is typed on `object-map`, `object-gantt` and `object-tree`.** Each row took `z.unknown()`, although each renderer hands the member to the console's shared navigation hook, which reads `navigation.mode` and falls back to `page`. Any value passed the component-props gate, and an off-shape one opened the record page in silence. Each row now takes the list view's `NavigationConfigSchema` by reference. That is the block `object-grid`, `object-kanban`, `object-calendar` and `object-timeline` already take.
2. **One enumeration pin holds the whole map.** `packages/spec/src/ui/component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts` walks every `ComponentPropsMap` row, into arrays, record values, union arms, lazy schemas and catchalls. It fails on any `z.unknown()` member that is neither typed nor listed with a recorded reason. It also fails on a ledger line whose member is no longer `z.unknown()`, so the ledger can only shrink as later stages type members.

**Why `Part of`, not a closing line:** the census found more than one reviewable PR's worth (the dispatch's size rule, A7). There are 31 renderer-read members. The precedent, PR #21463, spent about 1,100 lines on 7 members. The other 28 are recorded in the pin as `staged`, each with its reader at the pin and a named stage. The staging proposal below is in the report for a ruling. #21464 remains open for those stages.

### `navigation`, measured at the `.objectui-sha` pin `89cad75d55`

| row | was | now | read point at the pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-map` | `z.unknown()` | `NavigationConfigSchema`, by reference | `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx:1189` hands it to `useNavigationOverlay`, which reads `navigation?.mode ?? 'page'` (`react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts:364`) |
| `object-gantt` | `z.unknown()` | `NavigationConfigSchema`, by reference | `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx:1960` reads `schema.navigation ?? { mode: 'drawer' }` and hands it to the hook (`:2025-2026`) |
| `object-tree` | `z.unknown()` | `NavigationConfigSchema`, by reference | `plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx:1054` hands it to the hook (`:1046`) |

objectui's own node types and Zod mirrors already declare this member as `ViewNavigationConfig` or the spec's `NavigationConfigSchema` (`types/src/objectql.ts`, `types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`). The spec row now agrees with its sibling.

**No measured writer is refused (A3).**
- **objectstack, on the merged head:** 5 files per row name the type. None authors `navigation` on one of these blocks. The one co-mention writes app navigation arrays. Control: `objectName` is found in 4 of the 5 files per row.
- **objectui, at the pin:** 88 / 98 / 59 files name `object-map` / `object-gantt` / `object-tree`. Control: `objectName` is found in 55 / 70 / 40 of them. They contain 77 `navigation:` lines. Every distinct authored literal parses on all three rows, 36 of 36: `{ mode }` with each of the seven modes, plus `size: 'lg'` and `openNewTab`.
- The values that do not parse are probes that already expect a refusal. `navigation: 'anything'` is a both-faces parity probe. `navigation: 'drawer'` sits under a `@ts-expect-error`. `{ mode: 'sideways' }` is an expected `navigation.mode` issue.
- The `{ mode: 'drawer', width: '600px' }` example belongs to `object-view` (`plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:1060`), not these rows.

## The census (A1), whole

Writer counts are file co-mentions (a file naming the type and authoring `KEY:`), with a control key. They are an upper bound, not a value census: each later stage runs its own value-level census first.

**76 members with a recorded reason, grouped:**
- **slot (7):** child-component lists. Each is a declared slot position (§2 checks this), judged at its own node: `page:tabs` / `page:accordion` `items[].children[]`, `page:card` `children[]` / `footer[]`, `page:footer` / `page:sidebar` / `page:section` `children[]`.
- **runner (16):** `action:button` and `action:icon` `params`, `bodyExtra`, `bodyShape`, `operation`, `patch`, `toast`, `resultDialog` and `onSuccess`. Each `.describe()` says "forwarded to the runner" (§2 checks this).
- **records (18):** record rows and field values, shaped by the bound object's fields: `staticData[]`, `data[]`, `data.items[]`, `initialValues{}` / `initialData{}`, and the grid bulk action's `patch{}` / `params[].default`.
- **shared (35):** members of a schema another file owns. These are the expression AST beside every `source` (14), the HTTP data source's `params{}` / `body` (16), the inline JSON Schema document (4), and the bulk-action option entry, deliberately open (1).

**3 one-off reasons:**
- `element:definition-list` `items[].description` is shown as-is (`components/src/renderers/basic/data-list.tsx:68`, `toText`).
- `object-grid` `pagination.*` is a deliberately open `z.looseObject`, whose named members are typed.
- `ai:chat_window` `context{}` has no reader: objectui registers no renderer for the row (`components/src/renderers/placeholders.tsx:109-113`). Per A2 it is an open question, not a verdict (see the report).

## Held for a ruling: `object-kanban` `conditionalFormatting` (A3)

The list view's own `conditionalFormatting`, the shape the grid took in PR #21463, refuses both rule dialects that objectui's own kanban fixtures author:
- `{ field, operator, value, backgroundColor }` (`plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/ObjectKanban.structuredMembersReachTheirSinks-8313.test.tsx:463`) is refused with `unrecognized_keys` and `invalid_type@style`.
- `{ condition, backgroundColor }` (`:479`) is refused with `invalid_type@style` and `unrecognized_keys[backgroundColor]`.
- objectui's own `types/src/__tests__/kanban-conditional-formatting.test.ts:29-52` asserts that its kanban schema accepts both, and a mix of the two.

So the narrowing is not shipped. It is recorded as `staged('held-for-decision', …)` and reported with options.

## The pin, red then green (A4), and its ablation

- **Green on the final head:** `vitest run --project local … component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts` reports `Tests 51 passed (51)`.
- **Ablation.** The mutation reverts `object-map`'s `navigation` to `z.unknown()`, with no ledger line, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode under the verify lock. It landed: `anchor x1 → x0`, `replace x0 → x1`, blob `58b6e27fbc → 7e3b411604`.
  - The pin went **red**: `Tests 8 failed | 43 passed (51)`.
  - §1 received `["object-map navigation"]` against an expected `[]`.
  - §1's census read `expected 108 to be 107`.
  - The six object-map §4 cases failed (unwrap identity, parse equality, four refusals).
- **Restore, proven by blob:** `blob after restore 58b6e27fbc… == blob at HEAD 58b6e27fbc…`, `git diff HEAD empty`. The rerun was green again: `Tests 51 passed (51)`.
- The pin imports `./component.zod` from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
